content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Solana payments enable creators to sell digital products directly to customers using cryptocurrency, bypassing traditional payment processors. This method significantly reduces transaction fees compared to platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% per sale. With NOWPayments, creators only incur a 0.5% fee, allowing them to retain more of their earnings. For instance, selling 100 units of a $97 product through Gumroad would cost $970 in fees, whereas using NOWPayments would retain $921 for the creator. This cost efficiency is crucial for creators who want to maximize their income.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The underlying architecture of Solana payments involves a combination of decentralized finance (DeFi) and blockchain technology. When a customer makes a purchase, the transaction is processed on the Solana blockchain, ensuring security and transparency. The payment is confirmed on-chain, and with platforms like NOWPayments, creators receive automatic notifications through webhooks, streamlining the order fulfillment process. This eliminates delays and enhances the customer experience, allowing for instant delivery of digital products such as ebooks and courses.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This payment architecture is primarily built for digital creators in countries facing payment restrictions. It empowers them to sell a wide array of products—from templates and fonts to software—without relying on platforms that impose high fees or operate under restrictive policies. By offering an alternative that requires no KYC and supports multiple cryptocurrencies, Solana payments cater to a global audience of creators looking for autonomy and ownership over their income. This infrastructure ensures that creators can focus on their work without worrying about payment limitations.
Solana payments reduce transaction fees to 0.5%, maximizing your profits.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To successfully implement Solana payments for digital products, several components are essential. First, a reliable hosting service like Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages is needed to serve product files. Second, a backend solution like Cloudflare Workers ensures that payment logic runs smoothly. Third, NOWPayments allows for seamless cryptocurrency transactions. Together, these elements create a sovereign commerce stack that is not dependent on third-party platforms or subscriptions, providing creators with complete control over their sales.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start using Solana payments for your digital products, first, decide on the products you wish to sell. Next, set up your hosting using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to display your products. Implement a backend with Cloudflare Workers to handle transactions. Register with NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency, ensuring you understand the integration process. Finally, test the workflow to confirm that transactions and product delivery are functioning seamlessly. For those looking for a comprehensive solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which contains blueprints and templates to simplify the deployment process.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe can be achieved through Solana payments. This method allows creators to leverage cryptocurrency for transactions, with platforms like NOWPayments offering low fees and automatic payment processing. By utilizing this infrastructure, creators can efficiently sell digital products while avoiding the high costs of traditional payment processors.
Bypassing traditional platforms means you maintain full control over your sales.

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Begin by selecting the digital products you want to sell. Set up a hosting solution using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, implement backend logic with Cloudflare Workers to facilitate payment processing. Register for NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Test your system to ensure that payments and product deliveries are working correctly. Finally, review the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for additional resources and templates to streamline your deployment.

You can sell an ebook online by using cryptocurrency payment options like Solana. Platforms such as NOWPayments allow you to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies, eliminating the need for traditional payment processors.
